## Selected work

Book · 2022

### [Behavioral Political Economy and Democratic Theory](https://petrspecian.com/publications/book.html)

Examines the friction between modern technology and human rationality within liberal democracies, and advocates a behaviorally grounded theory of democracy for the digital age.

Routledge · 2022

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.4324/9781003274988) · [Publisher page](https://www.routledge.com/Behavioral-Political-Economy-and-Democratic-Theory-Fortifying-Democracy/Specian/p/book/9781032229737)

Journal article · 2026 · Open access

### [Machine Advisors: Integrating Large Language Models Into Democratic Assemblies](https://petrspecian.com/publications/machine-advisors.html)

Examines the integration of large language models into democratic assemblies: the promise of broader access to expert knowledge, and the risks posed by hallucination, opacity, and private control.

*Social Epistemology* 40(3), 393–408

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1080/02691728.2024.2379271) · [Full text](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/02691728.2024.2379271)

Journal article · 2025 · Open access

### [Universal Basic AI Access: Countering the Digital Divide](https://petrspecian.com/publications/universal-basic-ai-access.html)

A policy proposal for countering emerging digital divides in access to frontier generative AI.

*Acta Informatica Pragensia* 14(2), 272–281

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.18267/j.aip.270) · [Full text](https://aip.vse.cz/doi/10.18267/j.aip.270.pdf)

Working paper · 2026 · Open access

### [Built for Humans Only? Why AI Adoption in Higher Education Requires a New Deal](https://petrspecian.com/publications/built-for-humans-only.html)

Argues that bundling the authentication of student performance with its quantitative evaluation is no longer sustainable under generative AI, and proposes a New Deal Model built on student-owned, machine-readable portfolios.

SSRN working paper · 2026

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7258922) · [Full text](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7258922)

Working paper · 2026 · Open access

### [Digital Homunculi and Institutional Design: Breaking Through the Experimentation Bottleneck](https://petrspecian.com/publications/digital-homunculi.html)

Proposes generative agents as a way around the experimentation bottleneck in democracy research, and examines the methodological challenges involved.

arXiv:2409.00826

[DOI](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2409.00826) · [Full text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.00826)
